fields.name: site
fields.label: Site
fields.schema_description: Site containing the network devices to back up.

options.notes: From useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:34-41). The UI value is 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when the row has location_type, otherwise the bare id (location-options.ts:21-36). location_type is a repeated static query param.

fields.query_param_normalization: Resolved against loaded locations by encoded value, provider id, or display name; unresolvable resolves to '' (site-backup-workflow-form.tsx:125-130). The query is re-applied on every env-data change until the user edits any field.
fields.submit_transform: The encoded option is decoded: site = option id, or the raw form value if no option matches. The option's location type is emitted as site_type (:155-158).

fields.name: roles
fields.label: Roles
fields.schema_description: Device roles used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (getAll('role'), singular name). Values not matching a loaded option key are dropped; if none remain the field becomes [] (:88-99, :131).

fields.name: status
fields.label: Device Status
fields.schema_description: Device statuses used to filter the selected network devices.

options.notes: useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:54-63, 92-95). The UI default is DEFAULT_SITE_WORKFLOW_STATUSES (workflow-defaults.ts:18).

fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (getAll('status')). Values not matching a loaded option key are dropped; if none remain the field falls back to ['Active', 'Provisioned'] (:132-138).
client_only_validation: At least one item: 'Device Status is required' (:54-58)

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant
fields.schema_description: Tenant used to filter the selected network devices.

options.notes: useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:65-74, 96-99). Single select; the clear button sets ''.

fields.query_param_normalization: Single value. Kept only if it equals a loaded option key, otherwise '' (setSingleQueryValue :75-86, :139).
fields.submit_transform: '' becomes undefined, so the key is omitted from the JSON (tenant: data.tenant || undefined, :161).

fields.name: backup_enabled_only
fields.label: Backup enabled only
fields.description: Include only devices with backup enabled in the DCIM. Uncheck to back up all managed devices that match the other filters.
fields.schema_description: When true, only devices with backup enabled are included.
fields.query_param_normalization: Absent means true. Only a value that lower-cases to 'false' gives false; any other value gives true (parseBackupEnabledQuery :68-73).

fields.name: site_type
fields.schema_description: DCIM location type for the site identifier.
fields.widget_today: none (derived from the selected site option)
fields.submit_transform: location.locationType of the resolved site option (:158). JSON.stringify drops the key when it is undefined (bare-id options without location_type).

fields.name: user
fields.schema_description: User that requested the site backup.
fields.submit_transform: Never sent by the UI. The API fills it from the authenticated user when it is falsy (dynamic_endpoints.py:71-75).

fields.name: user_domain
fields.schema_description: Domain of the user requesting the site backup.
fields.submit_transform: Never sent by the UI. The API derives it from the user's email domain (dynamic_endpoints.py:78-81).

payload_transform: onSubmit (site-backup-workflow-form.tsx:153-173) resolves the selected site option and builds {site: option?.id ?? data.site, site_type: option?.locationType, roles, status, tenant: data.tenant || undefined, backup_enabled_only}. JSON.stringify in startWorkflow (utils.tsx:170) drops undefined keys, so site_type is omitted for bare-id options and tenant is omitted when empty. The body is POSTed to /v1/workflow/ngc/site_backup. user/user_domain are never sent; the API injects them (dynamic_endpoints.py:71-81).
discrepancies: The UI requires at least one status; the schema allows an empty list (default ['Active', 'Provisioned'], site_backup.py:69,117-120).
The roles field is pre-filled from the singular query param 'role'.
Label 'Device Status' differs from schema title 'Status'.
The schema properties user/user_domain are never rendered and are populated server-side. A schema-driven renderer would expose them as editable fields.
When empty, tenant is omitted from the payload instead of sent as null (the schema default is null). The two are semantically equivalent.
Query values are validated against option.key (display name). For roles/status/tenant the key equals the value (name), so this is equivalent to validating against values.
contract_gaps: No hidden or server-populated hint exists to suppress the user/user_domain schema properties.

site_type is a sibling filled from the selected site option's location_type, and the contract has no mechanism for that. The server pairs '<field>_type' by naming convention (workflow_submission.py:163), so site_reference could adopt the same convention if specified.
The location option source needs the repeated static param location_type=Site&location_type=Module, but OptionSource.params is scalar-only.
The status min-1 rule is client-only, with no minItems in the schema.
The empty-single-select-omits-key behaviour (instead of sending null or '') is unspecified.
Boolean query-param parsing for prefill (only 'false' means false) is unspecified.
